answer: To resist sybils%2C agents apply a pigment of sequential work%3A each identity must finish a hash spiral whose rounds equal the recent join rate%2C then whisper a compact proof of that pigment to the ledger. An attacker creating k fakes pays the sum of increasing spiral depths%2C which turns quadratic once the visible join count passes a threshold. Honest agents do one shallow spiral and reuse the whisper. The accumulating public pigment forces farms to burn rising compute with no cheap batch shortcut.
